[ASSISTANT] Assistant recommended several brands of basmati rice: Tilda, India Gate, Daawat, Zebra, and Lundberg, and provided tips on selecting quality basmati rice.  
[PREFERENCE] User has been using an authentic Japanese short-grain rice but is unsure if it would be suitable for the dinner party.  
[ASSISTANT] Assistant advised that Japanese short-grain rice is stickier and may not be the best fit for Indian-inspired dishes, recommending traditional Indian basmati rice instead.
